source.title: European Rubik's Cube Championship 2016 on July 15 - 17, 2016 in Prague, Czech Republic
source.content: The [European Rubik's Cube Championship 2016](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2016) will take place on July 15 - 17, 2016 in Prague, Czech Republic. Check out the [European Rubik's Cube Championship 2016 website](https://euro2016.cubing.net/) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2016 年欧洲魔方锦标赛将于 7 月 15–17 日在捷克布拉格举行
translation.content: [2016 年欧洲魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=Euro2016)将于 2016 年 7 月 15–17 日在捷克布拉格举行。更多信息及报名请访问[赛事网站](https://euro2016.cubing.net/)。
